rules.text:
HOW TO PLAY
SET FOR LIFE
Step 1,
Purchase a Ticket

Find an Arizona Lottery retailer and tell the cashier you’d like to purchase a Set For Life ticket. Tickets cannot be purchased online.

Step 2,
How to Play

Match any of YOUR NUMBERS to any of the WINNING NUMBERS, win prize shown for that number. Reveal a "" or "" MULTIPLIER symbol and multiply the prize shown by the MULTIPLIER symbol amount. 

Reveal a a "" symbol, win $250,000 A YEAR FOR 20 YEARS! 

BONUS: Reveal a cash prize amount in any BONUS spot, win that amount instantly!

Step 3,
Claim Your Winnings

All Arizona Lottery retailers will redeem prizes up to $100, and may redeem prizes up to $599. See full details about How to Claim Prizes.
